name: Balsu Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
summary: Balsu Gida Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi engages in production, processing, and logistics facilities in Turkey and internationally. The company supplies natural, roasted, blanched, and diced hazelnuts, as well as hazelnut pastes and meals. It exports its products to approximately 110 countries. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey.
